leg.text: Geyadrone Dihada offers to make Dakkon a planeswalker if he forges the Blackblade, and over ten years he forges it, killing a slave with it each time.
Dihada then ignites his spark but stabs the sword into his shadow and binds his soul into the blade, and she corrupts Sol'Kanar and sets about conquering Corondor.
Dakkon kills Piru in a blast that creates the Dueling Chasm, and Dihada absorbs the dragon's power and marks him, then reveals that the monk was herself and binds him to her for eternity.
Dihada leaves Dominaria and reappears at the Planeswalkers' War.

mh2.text: Dakkon forges the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada and unwittingly becomes part of her schemes.
